1911.unvetted: Series-level, no document or leaf seen. Ivanyi 1954 p.134 (Hungaricana, opened in Chrome) under 'Orosz kapcsolatok' says only Nedeczky Sandor's reports are 'nagyreszt rejtjeles'; Fogarasi Thalaba Mate's reports and copies of letters to the tsar are NOT called cipher, so the lead's pairing is too wide. Note 20 gives the units: G 15 Caps. A.1 Fasc. 2, 10; A.2 Fasc. 27; E Fasc. 111, 120; F Fasc. 149, 150, 156; H Fasc. 242. Earlier prior art stands: Zsemlye 2025 prints Nedeczky reports and a 1709 cipher letter copy (Ms. 4958/2/III), Lang 2018 pp.64, 94 on the clavis. Whether those reports were deciphered by the chancery needs the G 15 images or the reading room at MNL OL.
